content.html: Four statements about the reactions of oxides with dilute hydrochloric acid and with aqueous sodium hydroxide are listed.
content.text: Four statements about the reactions of oxides with dilute hydrochloric acid and with aqueous sodium hydroxide are listed.

rows: Aluminium oxide reacts with both dilute hydrochloric acid and aqueous sodium hydroxide.
Calcium oxide reacts with both dilute hydrochloric acid and aqueous sodium hydroxide.
Copper(II) oxide reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid but not with aqueous sodium hydroxide.
Sulfur dioxide does not react with either dilute hydrochloric acid or aqueous sodium hydroxide.
